PocketBridge vendors these browser libraries for its static transfer page:

- PeerJS 1.5.5, MIT. License: PEERJS-LICENSE.txt.
- PeerJS bundled dependencies: @msgpack/msgpack (ISC), eventemitter3 (MIT), peerjs-js-binarypack (MIT), sdp (MIT), and webrtc-adapter (BSD-3-Clause). License texts are included beside this file.
- qrcode 1.5.4, MIT. It bundles dijkstrajs (MIT). License texts are included beside this file.
- JSZip 3.10.1, dual licensed under MIT or GPL-3.0-or-later; PocketBridge uses it under MIT. It bundles lie (MIT), pako (MIT and Zlib), and setimmediate (MIT). License texts are included beside this file.

The minified browser bundles are peerjs.min.js, qrcode.min.js, and jszip.min.js. The files retain the third-party copyrights and notices listed above.
